turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
In general, tracking is created once your order leaves the warehouse. The timing depends on the products, destination and carrier.

For some deliveries, the tracking link may only arrive on the morning of delivery. With EDELIV, you should receive a notification 3 hours before the delivery window, followed by the live tracking link 1 hour before arrival.

For the exact status of your order, please send your order number, the email address used at checkout and the phone number used at checkout.

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Once the order is handed to the carrier, delivery time depends on the products, destination and carrier.

Small parcels: usually 48 to 72 hours, delivered to the ground floor.
A mattress ordered on its own, without removal services: express delivery within 48 hours.

Some carriers may provide the tracking link only on the morning of delivery.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail: Unfortunately, we can’t bring the delivery date forward. Your order will be delivered within the time window provided at checkout. The carrier may call as delivery approaches or if you’re absent.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: If the tracking does not move, first check the carrier’s tracking link for the latest status. If there has been no movement for more than 2 days, please send your order number, the email address used at checkout and the phone number used at checkout so the shipment can be checked.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
Log in to your Tediber account and open “Mes Commandes” (“My Orders”). Your tracking number will appear there once the order leaves the warehouse.

If it is not visible yet, the order may not have been handed to the carrier. Some delivery updates only appear as late as 1 hour before the courier arrives.

turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail: I need to locate the order first to see whether the delivery address can still be changed. Please send your order number, the email address used at checkout, and the phone number used at checkout.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
Compensation for a long delay is not automatic. Each situation needs to be reviewed based on the order and the delivery issue.

Please send your order number, the email address used at checkout, and the phone number used at checkout so the delay can be assessed.
